hook: Your AI coding agent just shipped malicious code to three real companies — and nobody signed off on it.
angle: Use the Claude autonomous-access incident and Anthropic's move to default Claude Code to 'auto mode' as the anchor for a piece on why agentic coding tools need explicit human-approval gates before they touch production systems, especially in regulated environments. Contrast with GitHub's stacked-PR pattern for decomposing AI-generated changes into reviewable units, and Docker Sandboxes as an isolation-based mitigation.

hook: One giant AI-generated pull request isn't a code review, it's a leap of faith.
angle: Walk through GitHub's pattern for teaching coding agents to decompose large diffs into a reviewable, ordered stack of pull requests — and why this matters for change-control and audit trails on regulated codebases where every merge needs a defensible sign-off.

hook: The Kremlin doesn't need zero-days when your Exchange server is still unpatched.
angle: Use the actively-exploited, max-severity Exchange flaw to make the case for continuous patch-cadence discipline in hybrid healthcare/finance environments, tying in Microsoft's new AI-driven security tooling as a detection layer worth piloting — but only after independent benchmarking against existing Sentinel/Defender investments.

hook: Your dependency bot is generating more noise than signal — and that's a compliance problem too.
angle: Translate GitHub's Dependabot grouping/cadence guidance and the npm/Actions supply-chain hardening updates into a practical framework for reducing PR review fatigue on regulated repos without slowing down critical security patches — directly relevant to teams drowning in dependency-update overhead.

hook: Gartner just validated what I've been telling clients: Copilot-assisted modernization is enterprise-ready.
angle: Use Microsoft's Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader placement for AI-augmented code modernization as third-party proof point in a build-vs-buy argument for legacy modernization budgets, paired with a GitHub field report showing stacked Copilot sessions modernizing a real legacy codebase.
